diagnosis: The subscription endpoint looks up a Subscription by primary key without scoping the query to the authenticated req.user.id. A Sequelize afterFind hook automatically resolves and attaches the associated PaymentMethod object (including cardholder name, billing address, card last 4 digits, and Stripe token). Any authenticated user can read sensitive billing and card details of other subscribers by changing the subscription ID.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/subscriptions/sub_vip_enterprise_8831 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.platform.com:8106
Authorization: Bearer <standard_customer_jwt>
